Comparison

ChatGPT vs Perplexity

A side-by-side look at ChatGPT and Perplexity, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose ChatGPT when your priority is: broad daily knowledge work where one assistant must cover writing, analysis and code. Choose Perplexity when your priority is: any question where you need the answer AND the sources it came from.

Pricing notes

ChatGPT

Free $0 (ad-supported since the 2026 ad rollout). Go $8/mo. Plus $20/mo. Pro sold as two usage tiers: $100/mo (5x Plus usage) and $200/mo (20x Plus usage, priority compute, ~250 Deep Research tasks). Business $20/seat/mo annual or $25/seat/mo monthly (2-seat minimum; cut from $25/$30 in April 2026); a Premium seat runs roughly $100-125. Enterprise custom, annual contract. API billed per token, separate bill.

Perplexity

Free $0. Pro $20/mo or $200/yr (~$16.67/mo, ~17% saving). Max $200/mo or ~$2,000/yr (~$167/mo; annual sold on web only, not App Store/Play). Education Pro $10/mo for verified students and educators via SheerID. Enterprise Pro $40/seat/mo or $400/yr. Enterprise Max $325/seat/mo. Comet Plus add-on $5. Sonar API from $1 per 1M tokens up to $15 per 1M output on Sonar Pro, plus per-request search fees.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: ChatGPT ↗ · Perplexity ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between ChatGPT and Perplexity?

ChatGPT: General-purpose conversational assistant built on OpenAI's GPT model family. Perplexity: AI answer engine that runs a live web search for every question and returns a synthesised answer with inline citations.

When should I choose ChatGPT over Perplexity?

ChatGPT is listed as best for: broad daily knowledge work where one assistant must cover writing, analysis and code. Perplexity is listed as best for: any question where you need the answer AND the sources it came from.

Do ChatGPT and Perplexity have a free plan?

ChatGPT: Yes. Perplexity: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
